name: DeckView
author: ernes
description: Shrinks cards in Slay the Spire 2 deck grid screens (deck view, draw/discard/exhaust piles, card library, and deck card-selection screens) so more cards fit on screen at once. Hovering a card enlarges it back to full size. Leaves the combat hand, inspect popup, shop, and reward screens at normal size. Toggle with the Mini-cards checkbox or T. Does not change cards, combat, rewards, saves, or any other gameplay. Targets Slay the Spire 2 v0.113.1.
